headline: Trump's cryptocurrency plunged. The president made a move
summary: Donald Trump invited holders of his $TRUMP cryptocurrency to a dinner on Sunday even though the token's value has fallen sharply. Buyers needed to purchase tokens worth $518 to qualify, according to The Washington Post.
why: Memecoins are highly speculative digital tokens, and their prices can swing sharply on sentiment and political association.
original_headline: Kryptowaluta Trumpa runęła. Prezydent wykonał ruch
